months.note: 4월 말에 일찍 도착하거나 10월까지 남는 개체도 드물게 있다.

summary: 여름철새로, 평지나 농가, 인가 주변의 숲에 산다. 먹이가 되는 개구리 등이 줄어들면서 개체 수가 영향을 받고 있다.

sexes.male: 윗면이 청회색이고 가슴이 옅은 분홍빛 주황색으로 무늬가 거의 없으며, 홍채가 검붉다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 조금 크고 윗면이 더 갈색을 띠며, 가슴과 배가 더 짙은 주황빛 갈색에 가로무늬가 있고 홍채가 노랗다.

young: 어린새는 윗면이 짙은 갈색에 옅은 깃 가장자리가 있고 얼굴이 회색이며, 흰 아랫면의 가슴에는 적갈색 세로무늬, 옆구리와 다리깃에는 가로무늬가 있다. 어른새와 달리 날개 끝의 검은색이 뚜렷하지 않다.

similar.how: 붉은배새매는 날개가 가늘고 뾰족하며, 날 때 날개 아랫면이 거의 무늬 없이 희고 날개 끝만 검다.

art.subject: Chinese Sparrowhawk (Accipiter soloensis), adult male, as seen in Korean lowland countryside from May to September: crown, nape, back and upperwings blue-grey, the head slightly darker; cheeks pale grey; throat whitish; breast and upper flanks plain pale orange-pink, unbarred or with only faint wavy bars, fading into a white lower belly, thighs and undertail coverts. Tail grey with faint narrow darker bars. Underwing almost unmarked whitish to pale buff, with sharply black tips to the outer primaries. Iris very dark red-brown; cere conspicuously swollen and orange; bill short, grey at the base and black at the tip; legs orange-yellow.
art.pose: perched on a branch at a woodland edge, watching for frogs
art.scene: Korean summer countryside: a grove of trees beside rice paddies on flat farmland; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: blue-grey upperparts, pale grey cheek, plain pale orange breast, white lower belly, dark red-brown eye, swollen orange cere, long wingtips reaching well down the grey tail
adult male, front view perched: pale orange breast grading into a white lower belly and white thighs, whitish throat, orange cere, orange-yellow feet
adult male, in flight seen from below: almost unmarked whitish underwing with sharply black outer primary tips, pale orange breast, white belly, faintly barred grey tail
art.build: Small hawk, a little smaller than a Feral Pigeon; females larger than males. Compact body, rounded head. For an Accipiter the wings are long and pointed; at rest the wingtips reach well down the tail, further than in other small Accipiters. Tail medium-long and square-ended. Legs orange-yellow. Hunts frogs and large insects from a perch at woodland edges beside paddies. In flight glides on pointed wings, looking pale below with dark wingtips.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow iris on the adult male; it is very dark red-brown (a yellow iris marks the female).
Do not cover the underparts with dense rufous or brown barring (Japanese or Eurasian Sparrowhawk).
Do not paint a barred underwing or a white supercilium; the underwing is plain pale with black tips.
Do not paint a small, flat yellow cere; this species has a swollen orange cere.
